"主体与姿态：一位女性，参照参考图像使用相同的脸部、发型与妆容。

"Subject and pose: A woman is created using the same face, hair and makeup as the reference image. She is wearing a crisp white button-down Oxford shirt with long sleeves, and a thigh-length taupe-brown narrow pin-stripe skirt. Seated side-profile on a vintage floral-upholstered sofa cropped to show only half of it, legs crossed elegantly at the knees, torso upright, straight posture and turned slightly towards the camera. Both forearms extend naturally across the lap, with hands clasped together, resting over her top knee. Head shown in three-quarter profile, chin level, eyes directed beyond the right edge of the frame, lips slightly parted. Natural skin texture and minimal visible styling.

Setting: Intimate, lived-in domestic sitting room with subdued traditional décor. A worn sofa featuring muted olive, ochre, burgundy and cream botanical upholstery occupies most of the frame. Behind the subject, a dark wooden sideboard supports a glowing table lamp with a cream pleated shade, a small vase of red flowers and a ceramic vessel. A dim adjoining area appears on the left, containing a softly reflected window, framed wall art and leafy houseplants. A heavily defocused cluster of pink-red flowers fills the lower foreground, creating depth and partial visual occlusion. Neutral grey-green walls and dark wooden furnishings complete the understated interior.

Camera: Vertical environmental portrait photographed from a seated eye-level perspective. Subject positioned slightly left frame of centre, with the face near the upper-left intersection and the practical lamp balancing the composition on the right. Normal-to-short-telephoto perspective, approximately 50–65 mm full-frame equivalent. Moderately shallow depth of field, with the face, shirt, hands and crossed legs rendered clearly while the foreground flowers and distant background remain softly blurred. Natural perspective, restrained compression, documentary-style framing, subtle asymmetry and gentle negative space around the subject’s line of sight.

Light: Mixed practical and ambient lighting. 5700K daylight enters from the right side of the frame, illuminating the front of the subject brighter than the rest of the room. Gradual light fall off keeping the rest of the room in low light condition. A bright tungsten table lamp in the rear-right creates an amber pool of light, visible wall gradients and a soft upward glow above the lampshade. Balanced exposure preserves detail in the white fabric while retaining deep, slightly crushed shadows in the left background and beneath the furniture. Low-key tonal structure, soft shadow transitions, restrained highlights and a deliberate warm-versus-cool colour contrast.

Other technicals: Cinematic analogue-film rendering with muted, earthy colours: olive green, tobacco brown, warm cream, burgundy and subdued red. Slightly cool green-cyan bias in the shadows, warm amber highlights around the lamp, natural midtones and softly rolled-off whites. Fine-to-moderate 35 mm film grain, subtle halation around the practical light, mild colour noise and a lightly textured negative-scan finish. Moderate contrast with rich blacks, restrained saturation and gentle edge softness. Editorial portrait photography with an intimate European art-house-film aesthetic, understated late-20th-century interior styling, candid realism and tactile fabric detail."

(Note: Style her hair to shoulder-length)

"主体与姿态：一位女性，参照参考图像使用相同的脸部、发型与妆容。她穿着挺括的白色长袖牛津纺纽扣衬衫，以及一条大腿长度的灰褐色细窄条纹裙。她以侧身轮廓坐姿坐在一张复古花卉软包沙发上，画面裁切只显示沙发的一半，双腿在膝部优雅交叠，躯干直立，姿态端正并略微朝向镜头。两条前臂自然地横放在腿上，双手交握，搭在上方的那侧膝盖上。头部呈四分之三侧面，下巴保持水平，目光望向画面右边缘之外，双唇微微分开。皮肤质感自然，发型妆造痕迹极简。

场景：私密、有人生活气息的家中客厅，装饰风格低调而传统。一张略显陈旧的沙发占据画面大部分，其花卉图案软包为低饱和的橄榄绿、赭石、酒红与奶油色。主体身后是一张深色木质餐边柜，柜上放着一盏散发暖光的台灯，配奶油色褶皱灯罩，另有一只插着红花的小花瓶和一件陶瓷器皿。画面左侧是昏暗的相邻区域，可见柔和反光的窗户、装裱的墙面艺术品以及绿植盆栽。一簇重度虚化的粉红至红色花朵充满画面下方前景，营造景深并形成部分视觉遮挡。中性灰绿色墙面与深色木质家具共同构成这处低调内景。

镜头：竖幅环境人像，以坐姿视线高度拍摄。主体位于画面中心偏左，面部靠近左上角交汇处，实景台灯在右侧平衡构图。标准至短焦视角，约相当于全画幅 50–65 mm。中等偏浅的景深，面部、衬衫、双手与交叠的双腿清晰呈现，而前景花朵与远处背景保持柔和虚化。透视自然，透视压缩克制，纪实式取景，略有不对称，并在主体视线方向留出柔和的负空间。

光线：实景光源与环境光混合。5700K 日光从画面右侧进入，使主体正面比房间其余部分更明亮。光线逐渐衰减，使房间其余部分保持低照度状态。右后方明亮的钨丝台灯形成一圈琥珀色光池、可见的墙面光影过渡，以及灯罩上方的柔和上溢光晕。曝光均衡，在保留白色织物细节的同时，维持左侧背景与家具下方的深浓、略微压暗的阴影。低调影调结构，阴影过渡柔和，高光克制，并刻意营造暖色与冷色的对比。

其他技术要点：电影感胶片化呈现，配色低饱和且偏大地色系：橄榄绿、烟草棕、暖奶油色、酒红与柔和的暗红。阴影略带冷调绿青偏移，灯具周围呈暖琥珀高光，中间调自然，白色柔滑过渡收尾。细腻至中等的 35 mm 胶片颗粒，实景光源周围有轻微光晕，适度色彩噪点，并带有轻微纹理的底片扫描质感。中等对比度、扎实的黑位、克制的饱和度与柔和的边缘虚化。时尚人像摄影，带有亲密的欧洲艺术电影气质、不张扬的20世纪后期室内陈设风格、坦率写实的真实感与可触摸的织物细节。"
